changes: Restricted NVIDIA/CUDA pip packages to Linux so macOS builds do not try to install them.
Kept the manual macOS GitHub Release workflow.
Kept package privacy checks for local data, uploads, jobs, env files and caches.
Kept packaged app data storage under Electron userData so each Mac starts clean.
known_risks: The macOS alpha build remains unsigned and not notarized, so first launch may require manual approval in macOS Gatekeeper.
The bundled Python runtime can make macOS artifacts large.
Release publication depends on GitHub Actions runner availability.
